from: chapitres 3 et 4 de la vidéo longue (rachats d'actions contre R&D, choix du 737 MAX, la facture ; coupé : 787, détails de MCAS, procès)
paragraphs: From 2013 to 2019, Boeing spent {forty-three billion dollars|$43 billion} buying back its own shares.
Over the same six years, it spent less than {sixteen billion|$16 billion} on research for its commercial airplanes.
In 2016, it even promised to hand all of its free cash flow back to shareholders.
Its best-seller, the 737, dated back to the 1960s. Instead of a new plane, Boeing put new engines on it: the 737 MAX.
Then the bill came. Two crashes that killed {three hundred and forty-six|346} people. A {twenty|20}-month grounding. About {twenty billion dollars|$20 billion} in direct costs.
From 2019 to 2024, Boeing lost almost {thirty-six billion dollars|$36 billion}. Then it had to sell new shares to raise cash. Full story on the channel.
